intro: Formative review of the B2 content, including the extension texts; it does not replace a full assessment of the level.

piezas.titulo: How the test works: «Déroulement de l'épreuve»
texto: Formative test of grammar, vocabulary and reading comprehension for this B2 course, with a reading from each extension chapter. The score guides review and does not certify the CEFR level.
Each question indicates the related chapter or text.

frases.estudio: La mairie a présenté un projet pour réduire la circulation dans le centre.
frases.alumno: The town hall presented a project to reduce traffic in the centre.
analisis: la mairie a présenté un projet
the town hall presented a project (passé composé of «présenter» with a masculine direct object)

frases.estudio: D'une part, une nouvelle ligne de bus serait créée ; d'autre part, plusieurs rues deviendraient piétonnes.
frases.alumno: On the one hand, a new bus line would be created; on the other, several streets would become pedestrian.
analisis: on the one hand (correlative ordering connector)
une nouvelle ligne de bus serait créée
a new bus line would be created (passive with the conditional present)
on the other hand (second correlative term)
several streets would become pedestrian (devenir in the conditional + plural feminine adjective)

frases.estudio: Selon la mairie, ces changements permettraient de diminuer la pollution et de faciliter les déplacements.
frases.alumno: According to the town hall, these changes would allow reducing pollution and making journeys easier.
analisis: according to the town hall (preposition «selon» introducing the institutional source)
these changes would allow (conditional present of «permettre», expressing a potential consequence)
and making journeys easier (coordination with «et» + «de» + infinitive)

frases.estudio: Pourtant, certains commerçants craignent que leurs clients ne puissent plus se garer à proximité.
frases.alumno: However, some shopkeepers fear that their customers will no longer be able to park nearby.
analisis: some shopkeepers fear (indefinite «certains» + «craindre» in the present)
que leurs clients ne puissent plus se garer
that their customers will no longer be able to park (completive «que» + expletive «ne» after «craindre» + subjunctive of «pouvoir» + reflexive infinitive)

frases.estudio: La décision sera prise après une consultation publique, prévue le mois prochain.
frases.alumno: The decision will be taken after a public consultation, planned for next month.
analisis: the decision will be taken (passive in the simple future: «être» in the future + agreeing participle «prise»)
after a public consultation (temporal preposition «après» + feminine noun and adjective)
planned for next month (agreeing adjectival participle «prévue» + time expression)

pregunta.texto: Chapter 74. «Je suis contente que vous ___ reçu ma réponse.» :: past subjunctive of «avoir»

opciones.texto: ayez
opciones.explicacion: «Avoir» in the present subjunctive + past participle.

opciones.texto: avez
opciones.explicacion: Indicative.

opciones.texto: auriez
opciones.explicacion: Conditional.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 75. Which form follows «au cas où» in careful standard French?

opciones.texto: Le conditionnel.
opciones.explicacion: Example: «au cas où il pleuvrait».

opciones.texto: Le futur simple.
opciones.explicacion: «au cas où il pleuvra» is avoided.

opciones.texto: Le subjonctif.
opciones.explicacion: That is not the mood required here.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 76. «Je répète la consigne de sorte que chacun ___ la comprendre.» (may include pieces of the language you are studying; copy those as they are)

opciones.texto: puisse
opciones.explicacion: Intended purpose + subjunctive.

opciones.texto: peut
opciones.explicacion: Indicative of an observed ability.

opciones.texto: pouvait
opciones.explicacion: Imperfect, without the intended value.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 77. Which connector concedes a point before the objection?

opciones.texto: Certes..., mais...
opciones.explicacion: One recognizes a point, then qualifies it.

opciones.texto: Par conséquent...
opciones.explicacion: It introduces a consequence.

opciones.texto: En raison de...
opciones.explicacion: It introduces a cause with a noun.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 78. «Le sujet ___ je parle est complexe.» (may include pieces of the language you are studying; copy those as they are)

opciones.texto: dont
opciones.explicacion: «Parler de» calls for «dont».

opciones.texto: auquel
opciones.explicacion: «Parler à» would have a different meaning.

opciones.texto: que
opciones.explicacion: The preposition «de» is missing.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 79. In «C'est Léa ___ a proposé ce projet», complete the relative pronoun.

opciones.texto: qui
opciones.explicacion: The pronoun takes up the subject.

opciones.texto: que
opciones.explicacion: «Que» takes up a direct complement.

opciones.texto: dont
opciones.explicacion: «Dont» takes up a complement introduced by «de».

pregunta.texto: Chapter 80. In indirect speech, «Je partirai» becomes after «il a dit»:

opciones.texto: qu'il partirait
opciones.explicacion: The future becomes the conditional after a past verb.

opciones.texto: qu'il partira
opciones.explicacion: The future stays unchanged in this case.

opciones.texto: qu'il soit parti
opciones.explicacion: That means he has already left.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 80. Which sentence is also correct?

opciones.texto: Je lui reproche qu'il ne soit pas venu.
opciones.explicacion: «Reprocher à quelqu'un que» + subjunctive exists.

opciones.texto: Je le reproche qu'il ne soit pas venu.
opciones.explicacion: The person complement is built with «à».

opciones.texto: Je lui reproche de qu'il ne soit pas venu.
opciones.explicacion: «De» and «que» are not combined like that.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 81. Which expression introduces a conclusion?

opciones.texto: En somme
opciones.explicacion: Used to summarize.

opciones.texto: D'une part
opciones.explicacion: Introduces a first aspect.

opciones.texto: À moins que
opciones.explicacion: Introduces an exception condition.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 82. Complete the sentence with the appropriate pronoun: «Je ___ fais réparer (ma voiture)».

opciones.texto: la
opciones.explicacion: The feminine direct object pronoun goes before the causative verb «faire».

opciones.texto: en
opciones.explicacion: It would be used for an indefinite quantity introduced by «de».

opciones.texto: lui
opciones.explicacion: It is an indirect object pronoun, incompatible with the direct object «ma voiture».

pregunta.texto: Chapter 82. «Il se fait tromper» means that:

opciones.texto: He is deceived.
opciones.explicacion: The subject receives the passive action through «se faire» + infinitive.

opciones.texto: He deceives someone.
opciones.explicacion: That would be an active form («il trompe quelqu'un»).

opciones.texto: He lets others deceive someone.
opciones.explicacion: The subject is not the agent of the deception.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 83. What is the passive in the future?

opciones.texto: Le projet sera annoncé demain.
opciones.explicacion: «Être» in the simple future («sera») + agreeing participle («annoncé»).

opciones.texto: Le projet a annoncé demain.
opciones.explicacion: The passive form is missing and the tense is past.

opciones.texto: Le projet est annoncé hier.
opciones.explicacion: The present tense does not agree with the adverb «hier».

pregunta.texto: Chapter 84. Choose the correct form with participle agreement: «Les lettres que j'ai ___ sont arrivées.»

opciones.texto: reçues
opciones.explicacion: «Les lettres» is feminine plural and comes before the verb with «avoir».

opciones.texto: reçu
opciones.explicacion: A form without agreement, incorrect here because the direct object comes before the verb.

opciones.texto: reçus
opciones.explicacion: A masculine plural form; «lettre» is a feminine noun.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 84. In «Quand il eut terminé, il partit», what does «eut terminé» express?

opciones.texto: An action prior to «partit», in the passé antérieur. (may include pieces of the language you are studying; copy those as they are)
opciones.explicacion: The auxiliary is in the passé simple.

opciones.texto: A future action.
opciones.explicacion: Both events belong to the past narrative.

opciones.texto: A habit.
opciones.explicacion: It is not a habitual imperfect.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 84. «Je cherche une solution qui ___ durable.» (may include pieces of the language you are studying; copy those as they are)

opciones.texto: soit
opciones.explicacion: Present subjunctive to express a desired solution not yet identified.

opciones.texto: est
opciones.explicacion: Indicative for a specific solution that already exists and is identified.

opciones.texto: sera
opciones.explicacion: Future indicative, inappropriate for an open search.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 75. In «Si elle avait lu le message, elle aurait compris», what does the sentence express?

opciones.texto: A past hypothesis that did not happen.
opciones.explicacion: «Si» + plus-que-parfait; result in the conditionnel passé.

opciones.texto: A real condition for tomorrow.
opciones.explicacion: The sentence talks about something unreal in the past.

opciones.texto: A command.
opciones.explicacion: It contains no imperative forms.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 78. «La maison dans laquelle elle habite» uses «laquelle» because:

opciones.texto: It agrees with «maison», feminine singular. (may include pieces of the language you are studying; copy those as they are)
opciones.explicacion: The compound relative agrees with its antecedent.

opciones.texto: «Habiter» always requires the feminine.
opciones.explicacion: The verb's government does not determine gender.

opciones.texto: «Dans» always requires «laquelle». (may include pieces of the language you are studying; copy those as they are)
opciones.explicacion: The form of the relative varies according to the gender and number of the antecedent.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 81. What function does «d'une part... d'autre part» have?

opciones.texto: Presenting two correlative aspects of an argument.
opciones.explicacion: It organizes and contrasts two points of view or factors.

opciones.texto: Presenting a cause and its immediate consequence.
opciones.explicacion: For that, causal and consecutive connectors are used.

opciones.texto: Introducing a hypothetical condition.
opciones.explicacion: It does not express a conditional value.

pregunta.texto: Reading. What is the main objective of the project?

opciones.texto: Reduce traffic in the centre.
opciones.explicacion: It is explained in the first sentence of the text.

opciones.texto: Close all the shops in the historic centre.
opciones.explicacion: The text does not propose closing shops.

opciones.texto: Increase the price of bus tickets.
opciones.explicacion: No fare is mentioned in the text.

pregunta.texto: Reading. Which two concrete measures are proposed?

opciones.texto: A new bus line and the pedestrianization of several streets.
opciones.explicacion: The second sentence presents both mobility actions.

opciones.texto: More parking spaces and new shops.
opciones.explicacion: Those proposals do not appear in the document.

opciones.texto: Cancelling the consultation and the immediate cut-off of road traffic.
opciones.explicacion: The consultation is the step before deciding, not a measure already carried out.

pregunta.texto: Reading. Why are some shopkeepers worried?

opciones.texto: They fear that their customers will no longer be able to park nearby.
opciones.explicacion: «Craignent que leurs clients ne puissent plus se garer à proximité».

opciones.texto: Because the public consultation has already formally rejected the project.
opciones.explicacion: The consultation is still pending for next month.

opciones.texto: Because they think car traffic will increase.
opciones.explicacion: The project pursues the opposite aim.

pregunta.texto: Reading. What logical value does the connector «pourtant» have in the text?

opciones.texto: It introduces an objection or a contrast against the expected benefits.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the expected benefit with the commercial concern.

opciones.texto: It introduces the cause that justifies the municipal measures.
opciones.explicacion: The justification is expressed with «permettraient de diminuer...».

opciones.texto: It sums up the final conclusion of the project.
opciones.explicacion: The decision has not yet been taken.

pregunta.texto: Reading. When will the decision on the project be taken?

opciones.texto: After the public consultation next month.
opciones.explicacion: The last sentence gives the prior condition and the time frame.

opciones.texto: Immediately before presenting the proposal to the media.
opciones.explicacion: The project has already been presented.

opciones.texto: On the same day the bus line works begin.
opciones.explicacion: The text does not mention that date.

pregunta.texto: Reading. Has the project already been definitively approved?

opciones.texto: No; the final decision depends on the results of the public consultation.
opciones.explicacion: The passive «sera prise après...» indicates that the decision is pending.

opciones.texto: Yes; all the streets have already become exclusively pedestrian.
opciones.explicacion: These are proposals under study.

opciones.texto: Yes; the public consultation has already ratified the mobility project.
opciones.explicacion: The consultation is planned for next month.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 86. Reading of «A press article»: choose the correct meaning.

frase.texto: L'article présente la baisse de fréquentation des centres-villes comme un phénomène récent, mais souligne que les chiffres varient selon les quartiers.

opciones.texto: The article presents the drop in visits to city centres as a recent phenomenon, but points out that the figures vary from one neighborhood to another.
opciones.explicacion: This is the information in the French sentence.

opciones.texto: A survey of 1,200 traders links this drop to rising rents and a change in shopping habits.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: However, the town hall recalls that pedestrian streets attract more visitors on market days.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 87. Reading of «Formal correspondence»: choose the correct meaning.

frase.texto: Madame, je reviens vers vous au sujet de la convention transmise le 3 mai, dont la date d'effet reste à confirmer.

opciones.texto: To meet the planned deadline, could you tell us whether the annexes must be initialled separately?
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: We have already sent the requested supporting documents, except the statement that we will send you tomorrow.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: Madam: I am writing to you again regarding the agreement sent on May 3, whose date of entry into force is still to be confirmed.
opciones.explicacion: This is the information in the French sentence.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 88. Reading of «Inform or persuade»: choose the correct meaning.

frase.texto: Le dossier d'une entreprise qualifie son nouveau service de « révolutionnaire » et promet une livraison sans attente.

opciones.texto: The company's file describes its new service as «revolutionary» and promises delivery without waiting.
opciones.explicacion: This is the information in the French sentence.

opciones.texto: It cites an average time of twelve minutes, without specifying the period or the source of the measurement.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: An independent association observes, in a larger sample, significant differences depending on the time and the area.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 89. Reading of «Weighing arguments»: choose the correct meaning.

frase.texto: La ville envisage un abonnement unique qui donnerait accès aux bus, aux tramways et aux vélos partagés.

opciones.texto: Certainly, the formula would simplify journeys and could reduce car use in the centre.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: However, the proposed fare remains high for households that only use public transport occasionally.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: The city is studying a single pass that would give access to buses, trams and shared bicycles.
opciones.explicacion: This is the information in the French sentence.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 90. Reading of «A report with recommendations»: choose the correct meaning.

frase.texto: Le rapport examine les déplacements de 340 salariés pendant six semaines, au moyen d'un journal de trajet quotidien.

opciones.texto: The report analyses the journeys of 340 employees over six weeks by means of a daily record of trips.
opciones.explicacion: This is the information in the French sentence.

opciones.texto: It notes that flexible hours reduce delays, but not the number of missed meetings.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: The authors recommend extending the trial to teams serving the public before generalizing the results.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 91. Reading of «Comparing several sources»: choose the correct meaning.

frase.texto: La note municipale fait état d'une hausse de 18 % des trajets à vélo entre avril et juin.

opciones.texto: A national survey, published that same week, shows an 11% rise over the whole year.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: A local group questions the comparison because the new count only covers the redeveloped roads.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: The municipal note reports an 18% increase in bicycle journeys between April and June.
opciones.explicacion: This is the information in the French sentence.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 92. Reading of «A specialised article»: choose the correct meaning.

frase.texto: L'article explique comment la restauration des zones humides améliore la biodiversité, en particulier dans les plaines agricoles.

opciones.texto: The article explains how restoring wetlands improves biodiversity, especially in agricultural plains.
opciones.explicacion: This is the information in the French sentence.

opciones.texto: These environments retain water during heavy rains and slow its flow towards watercourses.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: They also provide habitat for species that no longer find enough food in the fields.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 93. Reading of «Multi-step instructions»: choose the correct meaning.

frase.texto: Avant de valider le dossier, vérifiez que chaque pièce porte le numéro de référence indiqué sur la première page.

opciones.texto: Attach the annexes in the requested order, except those containing confidential data; these must be submitted separately.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: If a document is missing, save the draft without sending it and add a note indicating the expected deadline.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: Before validating the file, check that each document bears the reference number indicated on the first page.
opciones.explicacion: This is the information in the French sentence.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 94. Reading of «Nuances and expressions»: choose the correct meaning.

frase.texto: Dans son éditorial, la journaliste invite les lecteurs à prendre du recul avant de réagir à la première alerte.

opciones.texto: In her editorial, the journalist invites readers to step back before reacting to the first alert.
opciones.explicacion: This is the information in the French sentence.

opciones.texto: She reminds us that eye-catching headlines should not always be taken at face value.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: The expression is not a reproach to the public, but a warning against hasty conclusions.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 95. Reading of «Following references in a text»: choose the correct meaning.

frase.texto: La région a lancé une aide destinée aux petites librairies, dont plusieurs risquaient de fermer avant l'été.

opciones.texto: These can finance works, provided they keep their opening hours for at least a year.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: The measure, presented in the previous paragraph, also aims to preserve jobs in small city centres.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: The region launched an aid intended for small bookshops, several of which were at risk of closing before summer.
opciones.explicacion: This is the information in the French sentence.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 96. Reading of «Reading a contemporary debate»: choose the correct meaning.

frase.texto: Le débat sur les bibliothèques ouvertes le soir porte autant sur l'accès aux services que sur les conditions de travail.

opciones.texto: The debate about opening libraries in the evening concerns both access to services and working conditions.
opciones.explicacion: This is the information in the French sentence.

opciones.texto: The users interviewed believe these hours would make studying easier, especially for those who work.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: The staff express reservations due to a lack of enough personnel to cover the additional shifts.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 97. Reading of «Grammar at the service of meaning»: choose the correct meaning.

frase.texto: Bien que la commission ait reçu tous les avis, elle n'a pas encore arrêté sa décision.

opciones.texto: The report, which had been drafted before the consultation, will be completed with an annex.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: If the funding were confirmed, the works could start in June itself.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: Although the commission has received all the opinions, it has not yet made a decision.
opciones.explicacion: This is the information in the French sentence.

pregunta.texto: Chapter 98. Reading of «Synthesis of several documents»: choose the correct meaning.

frase.texto: Le conseil a voté la rénovation de la gare, mais le calendrier définitif dépend encore de l'appel d'offres.

opciones.texto: The council approved the renovation of the station, but the final schedule still depends on the public tender.
opciones.explicacion: This is the information in the French sentence.

opciones.texto: The technical note foresees a six-month partial closure and recommends keeping access to the platforms.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: A travellers' association supports the project, but asks for a solution for people with reduced mobility.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.
